title: Run manifest
description: runs/<run_id>/run.json: who produced a run's records, from what input, with what prompt, and what to be careful about.

run_id.description: <kind>--<YYYY-MM-DD>--<label>. Equals the folder name. Never reused, never renamed.

kind.description: The kind of metadata. Must be the run_id's prefix and match record_schema.

record_schema.description: Repo path of the schema every record in this run follows.

status.description: in_progress: records still being added. complete: finished, records frozen. superseded: replaced by superseded_by, kept for comparison. withdrawn: do not use.

model.description: Exact model id, or null when not recorded.

method.description: How requests were run, e.g. Message Batches API, agents in a cloud session.

params.description: Sampling and other settings, as sent.

code.description: Where the builder/loader code lives and at which commit.

sha256.description: sha256 of that file's bytes; checked by tools/validate.py.

verbatim.description: False when the file is a reconstruction rather than the text actually sent.

verified.description: True only when every slug was checked against the named taxonomy.

request_set.description: The request set the inputs were built as (e.g. headnotes-circuits-v1), or null.

source.description: Where the opinion text came from.

selection.description: How the decisions in this run were chosen.

counts.description: Checked against the records by tools/validate.py.

compare_with.description: Run ids or outside runs this one is meant to be compared with.

caveats.description: Everything a user of these records must know. One plain sentence each.
